verses.english: “These two individuals are easy to satisfy in the world.

verses.pali: Yo ca laddhaṁ laddhaṁ na nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṁ laddhaṁ na vissajjeti.
verses.english: One who does not continually hoard wealth, and one who does not continually waste wealth.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā sutappayā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two individuals who are easy to satisfy in the world.”
